extracted.intended_audience: university researchers, academic institutions, and research teams seeking basic research funding from the Army Research Office
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers and institutions on engaging with the Army Research Office (ARO) to obtain extramural basic research funding, including the ARO's priorities, expectations, and recommended engagement paths (e.g., ARL Broad Agency Announcement, program manager contact).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritizing high-payoff scientific breakthroughs
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO’s unique focus prioritizes high-payoff scientific breakthroughs to keep the Army at the forefront of technological innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should target transformative, high-impact scientific advances rather than incremental work; emphasize potential for game-changing outcomes and long-term payoff for Army capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extramural basic research focus
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO is the Army’s extramural basic research arm; it supports fundamental research that drives scientific discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit work that advances basic science and foundational understanding (as opposed to near-term product development). Frame proposals around scientific questions and fundamental advances that can enable future technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver disruption / drive future operational superiority
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO aims to create, direct and protect scientific discovery for the Army and drive the future operational superiority of Soldiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position research to contribute to future operational advantage; articulate how scientific outcomes could enable novel capabilities for Soldiers and the Army.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build and leverage university and institutional partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO is the Army’s front door to universities and builds partnerships with thousands of researchers and hundreds of institutions to accelerate game-changing technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals and engagements should demonstrate collaboration with academic institutions or other partners where appropriate; highlight institutional strength, existing collaborations, and how partnerships accelerate impact or transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support workforce development and STEM outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO mentors and educates to establish the Army’s future science and engineering workforce and participates in STEM outreach and apprenticeship programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include activities that contribute to training, mentoring, student involvement, apprenticeships, or broader STEM workforce development when relevant; describe plans for student support and educational outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-term vision and anticipation of future challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO program managers are national experts who anticipate future challenges and facilitate scientific discoveries with a long-term vision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align proposals with forward-looking research agendas; explain how the project anticipates and addresses emerging challenges or future operational needs rather than only short-term problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global reach and leveraging broad expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO funds research across many U.S. states and internationally, leveraging global expertise to strengthen outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where applicable, highlight international collaborations or access to expertise beyond a single institution or region; demonstrate how geographic or disciplinary breadth improves the research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on transition through trusted public/private/academic partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO leads public/private and academic collaborations, ensuring discoveries transition rapidly to applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe potential transition pathways, partnerships with industry or DoD stakeholders, and steps to move discoveries toward practical use; emphasize mechanisms that enable rapid transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage via the ARL Broad Agency Announcement (BAA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore funding opportunities and connect with ARO Program managers via the year-round ARL Broad Agency Announcement (BAA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the ARL BAA as the primary mechanism to identify opportunities and submit proposals; proactively contact ARO program managers to discuss alignment and relevance before submission. Also consider participation in ARO-sponsored STEM outreach and apprenticeship programs as engagement channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational credibility and institutional footprint
rubrics_metrics.description: ARO’s track record (e.g., supporting scientific breakthroughs and Nobel-winning work) reflects expectations for high-quality, impactful science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate institutional capacity and past achievements where relevant; show how the team and institution can deliver on ambitious, high-impact research aims consistent with ARO’s history and mission.
